A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EC-Diffuser study. All 24 pages of each version, including Appendices A-D, are readable and support comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original manipulation experiments, generalization tests, ablations, and generated trajectories in Section 5 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons, supplementary experiments, and Language-Table visualizations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1-4.3 retain the same frozen DLP representation, entity-centric Transformer, joint state-action diffusion, denoising objective, and MPC procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use PushCube, PushT, FrankaKitchen, and Language-Table, with identical object-count, goal-composition, and unseen-color/shape scenarios in Section 5 and Appendix D.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain VQ-BeT, Diffuser, EIT+BC, and EC Diffusion Policy. The ablation and alternative-representation comparator sets are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, training budgets, model configurations, and checkpoint selection remain unchanged. Both retain 96 configurations for PushCube/PushT, 100 sampled FrankaKitchen goals, and the 2700/300 Language-Table training/validation split.

E4.justification: The representation, diffusion, and state-generation ablations, temporal-attention analysis, alternative-input experiments, and unseen-object tests are identical in Sections 5.3-5.4 and Appendix D.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same five-seed standard deviations and temporal-attention T-test. No run-count disclosure, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical procedure changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains the three-cube EC-Diffuser success rate of 0.894 ± 0.025, and Table 13 retains the Slot Attention FrankaKitchen score of 3.340 ± 0.097.

T1.justification: The diffusion, AdaLN, denoising-loss, and DLP/Chamfer-KL formulations in Sections 3-4 and Appendix A are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about multi-object manipulation, joint state-action generation, and zero-shot compositional generalization.

C2.justification: Mechanism interpretations and limitations are retained, including dependence on demonstration and representation quality, inference cost, real-world visual complexity, and the dynamics mismatch for unfamiliar shapes.

D1.justification: Section 7 adds a project-specific EC-Diffuser repository link and states that code is provided for reproduction. Its pointer to Appendix C repeats existing documentation; implementation details, hyperparameters, and hardware information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning, citations, and the reference list are unchanged. Bibliography pagination changes without adding or removing cited works.

P1.justification: Section 7 expands from an ethics statement to a reproducibility and ethics statement, and Section 8 adds funding acknowledgments. Conference-status headers are added; scientific prose and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds conference headers and reflows the concluding pages and bibliography around the expanded statements and acknowledgments. Figures 1-16 and Tables 1-14 retain their content, structure, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: The new project-code pointer in Section 7 improves resource discoverability, and Section 8 adds funding transparency. These are limited documentation gains: the method, empirical evidence, and limitations are unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access information but do not verify repository contents or functionality.
